主要内容: At the Annual Meeting of Stockholders of Geospace Technologies Corporation (GEOSPACE) held on February 21, 2013, stockholders voted on three proposals. Proposal 1 involved the election of Mr. Gary D. Owens and Mr. William H. Moody as directors for three-year terms expiring in 2016. Proposal 2 was the ratification of the appointment of UHY, LLP as auditors for the year ending September 30, 2013. Proposal 3 was an advisory vote on executive compensation. All proposals were approved by the stockholders. The voting details for each proposal are provided in the filing, showing the number of votes cast for, against, and abstained from each proposal. The filing was signed by Thomas T. McEntire, Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Secretary of Geospace Technologies Corporation on February 22, 2013.
